input.rationale: The termination-effects provision (Section 4(c)) only stops the Services, revokes the licence and requires each Party to return or destroy the other's Confidential Information. There is no transition-assistance obligation and no obligation for Kubient to return or export AP's data (Requests and other data supplied to or processed by Kubient) in any timeframe or format, and no defined \"Customer Data\" anywhere in the Agreement. Nothing elsewhere (including the survival clause at p0070) cures this. We therefore insert the fallback-level exit clause: 90 days of transition assistance and export of AP's data within 30 days after expiry or termination. Preferred-level extras (six months at then-current rates, machine-readable format, certified deletion after return) are noted as our upgrade position but not required at the fallback target.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides at least 90 days of transition assistance.
Vendor exports Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.

proposal.summary: Insert fallback transition-assistance and data-export clause after termination effects
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 4(c) only ends the Services and addresses Confidential Information, so we added a short exit clause giving us 90 days of transition assistance and export of our data within 30 days of expiry or termination. This is our fallback position; our preferred position adds six months of assistance at then-current rates with certified deletion after return.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Kubient shall, at Customer's request, provide transition assistance for at least ninety (90) days following such expiry or termination, and shall within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination export and deliver to Customer all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Customer (including Requests).
